card.title: IPhone X - 12 Pro Max Fix A problem was detected with the TrueDepth camera

source.title: IPhone X - 12 Pro Max Fix A problem was detected with the TrueDepth camera

symptoms: A problem was detected with the TrueDepth camera

claims.statement: The 'problem was detected with the TrueDepth camera' message, common after liquid damage, is caused by the dot projector; a JC programmer's read test confirms it.
Fix with JC tag-on method: activate repair with the phone connected, then write data to a tag-on flex ('Write From AI') and fit it to the dot projector.
JC Face ID boards with a USB-C port on top must be powered from a fast-charging brick.

procedure: Remove dot projector and test it on JC V1S/V1SE/V1S Pro.
Run Activate Repair with the phone connected.
Detect the tag-on flex and write data.
Fold and fit the flex; set up Face ID.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
